$comment: The gate's DATA, kept out of the gate's logic — the same shape as
so adding a clause a reviewer re-caught is a data change, never a gate edit.
canonical   the one surface that OWNS the clause. Held to every qualifier
itself, because a canonical that loses one silently redefines
the rule every restatement is measured against.
detect      vocabulary that puts a file in scope. Deliberately broad: being
in scope only means the file is READ, never that it must restate.
restates    the signal that a passage ENUMERATES the rule rather than citing
it. Tuned tight — a pointer must stay a pointer without ceremony,
because pointer-not-copy is the outcome this gate is steering
toward. Widening this is how a new restatement gets caught.
qualifiers  what a restatement must carry to be complete. Each one is a
defect #1633 actually shipped, not a stylistic preference.
Patterns are Python regexes matched case-insensitively against the SPAN's own
text (or, for `restates`, against a contiguous run of untagged lines).

clauses.title: A finding this change introduced is never deferrable
clauses.restates: never defer(rable| a finding)|not deferrable|this change (introduced|is shipping)|introduced it

qualifiers.name: provenance-discriminator
qualifiers.pattern: base branch|on the base\b|this change (introduced|is shipping)|prior fix on this PR|did not reproduce
qualifiers.hint: name what decides provenance — whether the defect reproduced on the base branch — not merely that the finding is undeferrable

qualifiers.name: provenance-not-severity-or-file
qualifiers.pattern: never severity|not severity|regardless of severity|whichever file|at any size|never a qualifier
qualifiers.hint: state that provenance decides, never severity or the file the finding surfaced in — round 2 shipped a copy scoped by file rather than by base behavior

clauses.title: A deferral counts only when it is durable and findable

qualifiers.name: carries-the-findings-evidence
qualifiers.hint: say the tracker item carries the finding's own evidence — a bare title is a dropped finding wearing an id

qualifiers.name: id-cited-in-the-reply
qualifiers.hint: say the item's id is cited in the D5 reply — an item nobody can find from the thread is not a disposition

clauses.title: Resolution eligibility is a property of the whole thread

qualifiers.name: every-finding-scope
qualifiers.hint: scope eligibility to EVERY finding extracted from the thread — resolution is thread-level while dispositions are per-finding

qualifiers.name: disposition-fixed
qualifiers.pattern: fix now|pushed fix|fix pushed|pushed and cited
qualifiers.hint: enumerate the fixed disposition — a pushed fix cited by the D7 follow-up

qualifiers.name: disposition-deferred
qualifiers.hint: enumerate the deferred disposition — a `VALID (defer)` grounded per D4.6 with the item id cited

qualifiers.name: disposition-incorrect
qualifiers.hint: enumerate the incorrect disposition — `INCORRECT` with the counter-evidence posted

qualifiers.name: uncertain-holds-the-thread-open
qualifiers.hint: state that a single UNCERTAIN escalates and holds its whole thread open — resolving over one drops it from the readiness denominator

clauses.title: The context adjudicating a deferral is not the context merging on it
clauses.detect: D7\.5|never clears the gate|adjudicating context|authorizes a resolution|independent resolution dispatch
clauses.restates: never clears the gate|adjudicating context|authorizes a resolution|independent resolution dispatch

qualifiers.name: independent-adjudicating-context
qualifiers.pattern: independent (adjudicating|resolution)|adjudicating context must not|must not be the context
qualifiers.hint: name the requirement as a property — the context adjudicating the deferral must not be the context trying to merge

qualifiers.name: same-session-scope
qualifiers.hint: say the rule binds a merge THIS session performs — round 4 lost the authorization from all three merge-capable paths at once

qualifiers.name: fail-closed-fallback
qualifiers.pattern: leave the thread unresolved|do not merge|fail closed|neither resolves
qualifiers.hint: state the fallback where no independent dispatch is reachable — leave the thread unresolved and do not merge
